trace.final:
Done — summary of what happened:

1. **Pre-check**: Production was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy (18% error rate across us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.2 had no prior production history, so per policy I obtained **change-manager approval** for the deploy — approved.
2. **Deployed v2.3.2** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollout verified.
3. **Post-deploy verification**: checkout-api is now healthy everywhere on v2.3.2 with error rate down to ~0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV3 incident** `INC-0001` recording the change: unhealthy v2.3.1 at 18% error rate → hotfix v2.3.2 deployed with change-manager approval, service now healthy.
